submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Keloid on Melanin Skin (dark-skin scar confidence)"
finding.problem: "All the scar papers show white skin. My keloid is dark and raised and I'm terrified it'll stay like this forever. No one talks about Black women's scars."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 27-yr-old Ghanaian-British mom; raised dark keloid forming on her brown skin; feels ugly and worries it's "permanent evidence" of surgery; no resource addresses Black skin.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (melanin-skin scar care) — strong diaspora differentiation.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
